{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("First few rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column type and example values
print("\nRevenue column dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Example revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:\n", df['status'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print("\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Show example of QA order
if qa_mask.any():
    print("Example QA order:")
    print(df[qa_mask].head())"}
